svg.title: Services directory: what I build
svg.desc: A newspaper services directory listing what Intikhab Azam builds: AI voice agents (Vapi · Twilio · CRMs · payments · SMS); RAG and LLM agents (tool calling · memory · search); LLM evals and research (calibration · benchmarks · backtests); Multi-tenant SaaS architecture (Postgres RLS · BFF auth · encryption); Agentic coding (Claude Code · Codex · DeepSeek); Automation and data pipelines (n8n · Cloudflare Workers); Developer tools and CI checks (PyPI · npm · GitHub Actions · MCP).
